desc: The HUD in battle (Petal Meadows, battle 4: the command menu, then a jump and its earned Star Points at the lower right, the audience count at the lower left) at a 19.5:9 phone held sideways (Aspect ratio: the window's own, the picture kept clear of the notch). Widescreen HUD at the edges on (the default): HP and FP at the frame's left edge; Star Power, Star Points and coins at its right
